# M1-10 — Engineering Decision Log Setup & Initial Decisions

## Labels
`docs`, `milestone-1`, `priority-medium`

## Milestone
Milestone 1 — Engineering Foundation & Requirements Baseline

## Tasks
- [ ] Create the Decision Log structure (Decision ID, Context, Constraints, Alternatives, Decision, Rationale, Trade-offs, Risks, Evidence, Later Consequence)
- [ ] Record only genuine M1-level decisions already made (e.g. process, working agreement, governance model)
- [ ] Record at least one justified deferment where evidence is not yet sufficient (e.g. technology/architecture choices deferred to M2)
- [ ] Select one decision (made or deferred) and prepare its defence
- [ ] Integrate the Decision Log into PED v1.0

## Acceptance Criteria
- Log structure matches the Master Project Brief's Decision/ADR standard.
- Entries reflect real M1 decisions, not invented ones to fill the template.
- At least one deliberate deferment clearly states what evidence is still required before deciding.
- Team can defend a chosen decision: alternatives considered, rationale, trade-offs, risk.
